answers.question: 160/05 Q1 · When a whole-tree gate run reaches its 10-minute budget, should it stop there or run to the end and then fail? Stopping answers at 10 minutes: units still running are reported not finished, the rest not started, and those unrun cases go unchecked. Running on reports every failure, but can take the ~48 minutes it takes today.

160/05 Q2 · Should a --serial gate run (about 1¾ hours, the fallback when the sharded run can't be trusted) still be able to sign a milestone off? If yes, the 10-minute budget binds only the sharded gate. If no, every sign-off must come from a run inside the budget.
